law_record.title: Stopping, standing or parking in zone for loading passengers at curb
law_record.text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle for any purpose or period of time except for the expeditious loading or unloading of passengers in any place marked as a passenger curb loading zone during hours when the regulations applicable to such passenger curb loading zone are effective.

activation_conditions: the place is marked as a passenger curb loading zone
the zone's regulations are in effect at the time
the subject stops, stands or parks there for any purpose other than expeditious passenger loading or unloading
exceptions: expeditious loading or unloading of passengers
residue: the zone's effective hours come from its sign; without them the rule reports unknown
this line is in the corpus because the narrower municipal text that superseded it is unresolvable
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: 'for any purpose or period of time' — no duration makes another use lawful; 'expeditious' bounds the permitted one and must be declared
the prohibition runs only during the zone's effective hours, read from its sign
